comments.text: 🇵🇱 Wroclaw Centennial Hall built 1913. I went there. Totally random cement dome theater hall near a fountain built in German times there. I guess it's the first concrete reinforced steel building of its type copied all over the world after. 🇰🇷 Suwon Fortress. It's a 5K walk to walk around it, just to the south of Seoul. It's cool, but not out of this world amazing. Like 250 years old built for an attack that never happened. But sidenote since all Korean historical sites were made of wood, mostly long gone especially because of the 1500s Imijin War when the Japanese burnt most things down, so most things are restorations in Korea. It's some of the oldest original wood structures and walls in Korea still intact.
